observations.label: Governing coalition continuity
observations.summary: Four levers changed hands in three weeks: finance minister (09-14), Bank Indonesia governor sworn in (09-20), a broad cabinet reshuffle removing the foreign minister (10-01/02, 3-5 sources), and a new national police chief with 19 regional chiefs and 27 senior officers reassigned (10-01/03/04, 3-4 sources). Each is defensible alone; together they are a concentration of control. No V3 driver moved - the capture driver counts politicised institutions, not the frequency or clustering of turnover, and that gap is recorded as a methodology item.

observations.label: Offline mobilisation event pool
observations.summary: Five consecutive days of protest 2026-08-27 to 08-31: nationwide demonstrations over the delayed asset-forfeiture bill, 322 arrests and one death in Jakarta on 08-28, a riot outside the parliament building on 08-29 with hundreds detained. The person killed belonged to the civil group GRIB Jaya, so this is no longer student-only. Still short of a regime-change demand and materially smaller than the August 2025 wave (10 dead, 3,000+ arrested); 08-27 was that wave's first anniversary.
observations.carryForwardReason: 8/27–8/31 那轮是本 driver 最后一次有实体动员的观测；此后街头无新动员，热度已回到骚乱前以下。**沿用的是「跨阶层持续动员」这一定性而非当日事件**——定性未被新事实推翻。⚠️ 10-06《劳动保护法》改遣散费与 2027 最低工资谈判已把下一轮引信装好，一旦出现实体动员须立即替换。
